title: Verify delivery fee is consistently applied to all orders
gherkin:
Given a customer places an order
When the order is processed for billing
Then the delivery fee should be applied consistently according to the defined rate
And the delivery fee amount should match the expected fee for the delivery distance/zone
rationale: Ensures that every order receives the same delivery fee calculation without exceptions or variations
generationSummary: Delivery fee billing consistency ensures that delivery fees are calculated, applied, and billed uniformly across all orders and customer segments without discrepancies or variations in the billing process.

title: Verify delivery fee is consistent across different customer segments
gherkin:
Given customers from different segments (new, regular, premium)
When each customer places an order
Then the delivery fee calculation should be consistent
And the same delivery distance should result in the same delivery fee for all segments
rationale: Confirms that delivery fee billing does not vary based on customer type or segment unless explicitly defined
generationSummary: Delivery fee billing consistency ensures that delivery fees are calculated, applied, and billed uniformly across all orders and customer segments without discrepancies or variations in the billing process.

title: Verify delivery fee remains consistent across multiple orders from same customer
gherkin:
Given a customer has placed multiple orders
When each order is billed
Then the delivery fee for the same delivery distance should be identical across all orders
And no variation should exist in the billing amount
rationale: Ensures that a customer is not charged different delivery fees for similar delivery conditions across different orders
generationSummary: Delivery fee billing consistency ensures that delivery fees are calculated, applied, and billed uniformly across all orders and customer segments without discrepancies or variations in the billing process.

title: Verify delivery fee consistency in billing records
gherkin:
Given an order with a delivery fee has been processed
When the billing record is generated
Then the delivery fee in the invoice should match the delivery fee charged at order processing
And the billing record should reflect the consistent fee amount
rationale: Validates that the delivery fee recorded in billing documentation is consistent with what was charged
generationSummary: Delivery fee billing consistency ensures that delivery fees are calculated, applied, and billed uniformly across all orders and customer segments without discrepancies or variations in the billing process.

title: Verify delivery fee consistency across different delivery zones
gherkin:
Given orders being delivered to different zones
When each order is billed
Then orders in the same zone should have the same delivery fee
And the fee should be consistently applied based on zone definition
rationale: Ensures that delivery fee billing is uniform within defined geographic zones
generationSummary: Delivery fee billing consistency ensures that delivery fees are calculated, applied, and billed uniformly across all orders and customer segments without discrepancies or variations in the billing process.

title: Verify delivery fee consistency when applied with discounts
gherkin:
Given an order with a discount applied
When the delivery fee is calculated
Then the delivery fee should remain consistent regardless of order discounts
And the delivery fee should not be affected by promotional offers on the order total
rationale: Confirms that delivery fee billing consistency is maintained independently of other billing adjustments
generationSummary: Delivery fee billing consistency ensures that delivery fees are calculated, applied, and billed uniformly across all orders and customer segments without discrepancies or variations in the billing process.

title: Verify delivery fee consistency in refund scenarios
gherkin:
Given an order with a delivery fee that is being refunded
When the refund is processed
Then the delivery fee refund amount should match the original delivery fee charged
And the refund should be consistent with the original billing
rationale: Ensures that delivery fee billing consistency extends to refund processing
generationSummary: Delivery fee billing consistency ensures that delivery fees are calculated, applied, and billed uniformly across all orders and customer segments without discrepancies or variations in the billing process.

title: Verify delivery fee consistency across payment methods
gherkin:
Given the same order placed with different payment methods
When the delivery fee is calculated
Then the delivery fee should be identical regardless of payment method used
And the billing amount should remain consistent
rationale: Validates that delivery fee billing does not vary based on the payment method selected
generationSummary: Delivery fee billing consistency ensures that delivery fees are calculated, applied, and billed uniformly across all orders and customer segments without discrepancies or variations in the billing process.

title: Verify delivery fee consistency in billing system audit trail
gherkin:
Given multiple orders with delivery fees
When the billing audit trail is reviewed
Then all delivery fees should be consistently recorded
And the audit trail should show no discrepancies in fee application
rationale: Ensures that the billing system maintains consistent records of delivery fees for audit purposes
generationSummary: Delivery fee billing consistency ensures that delivery fees are calculated, applied, and billed uniformly across all orders and customer segments without discrepancies or variations in the billing process.

title: Verify delivery fee consistency across system updates
gherkin:
Given a system update that affects delivery fee calculations
When orders are processed before and after the update
Then the delivery fee should be consistently applied according to the current rules
And there should be no inconsistency in billing between pre and post-update orders with same delivery parameters
rationale: Confirms that delivery fee billing consistency is maintained even when system changes occur
generationSummary: Delivery fee billing consistency ensures that delivery fees are calculated, applied, and billed uniformly across all orders and customer segments without discrepancies or variations in the billing process.
